svg.title: Tibbly in RuneLite
svg.desc: A branded illustration of the Tibbly panel. The player asks: Stuck on Dragon Slayer II after the Vorkath cutscene. Where do I go? Tibbly answers: The dragon key piece is in your bank, tab 3. Take your digsite pendant back to the Lithkren vault. Gold lines connect the answer to bank tab 3, the Dragon Slayer II quest, and a digsite pendant in the inventory.
